response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile software developer with 15+ years across web, backend, and some systems programming, but the role's core requirement — deep, current C++ expertise for industrial automation — is largely absent. His C++ work dates back roughly a decade (National Instruments, 2014–2015), and his recent career centers on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and DLang work. There is no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL experience, MQTT, industrial protocols, or Azure. While his low-latency DLang microservices experience shows relevant systems thinking, the mismatch on the primary skill set and security domain makes him a poor fit for this specific role.
strengths: Strong systems/performance background (low-latency, async I/O, high-throughput microservices in DLang)
Broad, senior-level engineering experience with TDD, CI/CD, and mentoring/teaching track record
Some hands-on C/C++ exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI components, C++ audio thesis project)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and ~10 years stale; recent work is TypeScript/Node.js focused
No industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443), SDL, MQTT, or industrial protocol experience
No Azure or industrial automation/IoT domain background; message-broker experience not clearly demonstrated

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and performance-systems background
